verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents several AI-driven tools that generate insights from data — Luminance for AI-assisted document review, Evaluate for automated analysis of bidder responses, and a Legora collaboration for a generative AI legal assistant — showing genuine AI-insight capability embedded in client-facing tools. However, these are only briefly described marketing blurbs without detail on how insights are surfaced to an end user, and most of the tool suite (SCC/Term Sheet generators) is document-automation via questionnaire rather than AI-generated insight. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of AI insight generation, detail on user interface/output for these tools, and confirmation these are broadly available rather than firm-internal.
